messages.text: Hi, I returned the glass kettle. Will the shipping I paid be refunded too, or just the kettle?

messages.text:
Shipping charges are never refunded automatically (refund-policy/v2/shipping). Refunds cover only what you paid for the unit itself, so shipping isn't part of the amount (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Our records show the glass electric kettle (order d39-o1) was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). It cost 139.90 BRL, and the order is still within its refund window.

I can propose a refund for the kettle. If you also want the shipping charge looked at, a staff member can review it. Would you like me to propose the kettle refund, or would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge, or both?
